text:
release-lead: Heads up — we're sunsetting the "static-canary" gating policy and enabling the new Adaptive Canary (v1) next Thu 11:00-12:00 PT. This is a configuration change only; no code deploy. Please read the rollout plan.

lia: Does this require a release freeze?

release-lead: No full freeze. We'll have a brief canary-only hold for 11:00-11:20 PT while we flip the policy flag. New canaries created during the hold will start with Adaptive rules; existing canaries continue under static rules until they redeploy.

oscar: What are the new abort thresholds?

release-lead: Adaptive defaults (copy to runbook):
- abort if weighted-error-rate > 0.6% over 4m
- abort if p95 latency increases > 20% vs dynamic baseline for 5m
- abort if regression_score > 2% on smoke set
If abort triggers: auto-scale canary to 0, fallback to variant, and open rollback ticket.

sre-oncall: Paging behavior?

release-lead: Alerts include `abort-reason` and will page #eng-oncall. Oncall may run: rdeploy rollback --deploy-id ID --reason "adaptive-abort" --no-confirm

account-eng: Impact to Dedicated customers?

release-lead: For pinned Dedicated pools we default to variant routing; we will not evict pinned jobs. If a customer opted into policy migration, we'll coordinate per-account.

deploy-bot: Preflight check: feature-flag flip staged in staging. Will post 1h and 10m reminders.

lia: I'll update the release playbook and send a short notice in the weekly release email.

oscar: Adding a small smoke sim PR to infra/sim so the switch is deterministic. Tagging release-lead.

release-lead: Thanks. Block 10:45-12:15 PT if you're on the pager list. If blockers surface, flag here. We'll run a 15m observation after the flip and collect a short decision log.

deploy-bot: Feature flag flip scheduled Thu 11:05 PT. Ready.
